svg.title: Red Yellow Blue III
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; vivid screen colour not calibrated. Three separate almost-square panels in observed red/yellow/blue order. Individual aspect uses each-panel dimensions; gaps approximate, overall width unknown.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.walkerart.org/collections/artwork/red-yellow-blue-iii/; source object 1998.13.1-.3; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
